title: Longitudinal EEG Test-Retest Reliability in Healthy Individuals
description: This dataset contains longitudinal resting-state EEG recordings from 43 healthy adults across four sessions spanning about two years, with an average inter-session interval of 7.2 months. It was collected to evaluate the test-retest reliability of EEG measures processed with an automated pipeline combining independent component analysis and wavelet-enhanced artifact removal. The data support analyses of neural components, relative power in regions of interest, and the longitudinal stability of quantitative EEG.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded from healthy adults in four sessions over approximately two years. Raw data are organized in BIDS format (BrainVision .eeg/.vhdr/.vmrk files). The associated analysis used an automated preprocessing pipeline with independent component analysis and wavelet-enhanced artifact removal.
